description: Veyra module layers, bottom to top (ADR-006 §3). A module may depend only on modules in lower layers: never on itself, on a module in its own layer, on a higher layer, or on any sealed layer. scripts/check_module_layers.py enforces this in CI. The milestone that creates a module adds it here; gameplay layers go between Foundation and Composition.

layers.name: Foundation
layers.description: Lowest Veyra-owned foundation. Depends on no other Veyra module.

layers.name: Composition
layers.description: The composition root. Sealed: nothing depends on it.

layers.name: Developer
layers.description: Automation tests and developer tooling. Sealed: production modules never depend on it.
